content: Econazole topical foam is intended for external use on the skin only. It must not be applied to the eyes or the vagina. Econazole topical foam is a prescription medication designed for the treatment of athlete’s foot (interdigital tinea pedis) that occurs between the toes. It is approved for use in individuals aged 12 years and older. Before using Econazole topical foam, inform your doctor about all your medical conditions, including if you are pregnant or planning to become pregnant. It is not known whether this medication can harm an unborn baby. Additionally, let your doctor know if you are breastfeeding or planning to breastfeed, as it is unclear if the medication passes into breast milk. Provide your doctor with a complete list of all medications you are taking, including prescription drugs, over-the-counter medications, vitamins, and herbal supplements. Use Econazole topical foam exactly as directed by your doctor. Apply the foam to the affected areas of the skin on your feet once daily for four weeks. If the foam comes into contact with your eyes or the area around them, rinse thoroughly with water. Wash your hands after applying the foam. Avoid exposing Econazole topical foam to heat, flames, or smoking during and immediately after application, as the foam is flammable. Econazole topical foam may cause skin reactions at the site of application. Notify your doctor if you experience any skin reactions in the treated areas. These are not all the possible side effects of the medication. For medical advice about side effects, contact your doctor. You can also report side effects to the FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088. Store Econazole topical foam at room temperature, between 68°F and 77°F (20°C to 25°C). Do not refrigerate or freeze the foam. Keep it away from direct sunlight. The foam is flammable, so ensure the canister is stored away from heat and temperatures above 120°F (49°C), even if the canister is empty. Do not puncture or burn the canister. Keep this medication and all other medicines out of the reach of children. For safe and effective use, follow the detailed instructions provided. Medications are sometimes prescribed for purposes other than those listed in the patient information leaflet. Consult your doctor or pharmacist for additional information about Econazole topical foam written for healthcare professionals. Do not use this medication for a condition for which it was not prescribed, and do not share it with others, even if they have the same symptoms, as it may harm them. The active ingredient in Econazole topical foam is econazole nitrate. The inactive ingredients include dimethicone, glycerin, polysorbate 20, povidone, propylene glycol, stearic acid, triethanolamine, purified water, and butane as a propellant. For further information, contact the manufacturer, Quinnova Pharmaceuticals, LLC, at 1-877-660-6263.
